answer: A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The spiral counter is kept in willow and vault makes public each reset. An hostile operator as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 58 aliases cost 117 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
